notes: On machines whose graphics hardware can carry it, the air of the Reach is now a real volume: the low sun draws visible shafts through the drifting ash, and the haze pools thicker in the hollows around you instead of only tinting the distance.

The game checks what your hardware supports before turning this on. Machines that can't render it safely see exactly what they saw before — the same clean frame with the same distance haze — rather than a broken screen.
title: Light through the ash
